title: Concept: Absolute node_modules path in a response
description: An absolute path into a node_modules directory in a response gives every reader of that response the same information the bank holds internally: The path discloses the deployment root, the operating system and the exact dependency layout, which lets an attacker match a known vulnerable package version without touching the server.
applicability: Dependency paths and versions turn blind probing into a targeted exploit choice.
risk: Filesystem layout is server-side information with no use in a response.
